categories.name: Public Registration Display
categories.description: Every listing must display a valid registration number (Registriernummer) from the district office.

binary_check.failure_message: CRITICAL: Listing is missing the mandatory 'Registriernummer'. This is an immediate administrative offense.

agent_instructions.if_compliant: Verify format is 'ZE/ZA/...' + digits. Confirm valid.

if_violated.user_message: You must apply for a registration number immediately. Use this link for primary residences.

categories.name: Primary Residence Sharing (Homesharing)
categories.description: If the host lives in the unit, they can rent out space without a permit ONLY if they occupy more than 50% of the space themselves.

binary_check.failure_message: If this is a primary residence, renting out >50% of the space requires a full misappropriation permit.

agent_instructions.if_compliant: No further action needed. Keep rental area under 50%.

if_violated.user_message: You are renting out more than 50% of your home. You must download and fill out this specific application form.

categories.name: Second Home Time Limit
categories.description: Secondary residences (Nebenwohnungen) can only be rented out for short-term stays for a maximum of 90 days per year.

binary_check.failure_message: Renting a second home for more than 90 days/year is prohibited without a hardship permit.

agent_instructions.if_compliant: Monitor rental days to stay under 90.

if_violated.user_message: Renting >90 days requires a Hardship Permit. Please complete the attached PDF application.

categories.name: Vacancy Limit (Leerstand)
categories.description: Residential units cannot remain empty (vacant) for longer than 3 months.

binary_check.failure_message: Vacancy exceeds the 3-month legal limit. Justification (e.g., renovation) is required.

if_violated.user_message: Your property has been empty too long. Notify the district office immediately.

categories.name: Commercial Misappropriation
categories.description: Using residential space for purely commercial purposes (e.g., permanent office, medical practice) is banned.

binary_check.failure_message: Property is being used for commercial purposes without a permit.

if_violated.user_message: Commercial use is strictly regulated. Use this form to apply for a conversion permit.

categories.name: Structural Integrity
categories.description: Modifications that make the unit uninhabitable (e.g., removing kitchen/bath) are prohibited.

binary_check.failure_message: Structural changes have rendered the unit uninhabitable.

if_violated.question: Please describe the renovations. Are they temporary?
if_violated.user_message: Making a unit uninhabitable is illegal. If this is a renovation, verify the timeline.
